So you've got 1419 different chromosomes read. Most likely there is
something odd with your file. You can troubleshoot the whole thing by
loading a fresh R session and try to read the tabular file using
read.table(). Something like:

df <- read.table(pathname, header=TRUE, sep="\t", ...)

With the 'nrow' argument you can loads parts of the file. See if you
can figure out what's wrong. When you get str(df) to return something
decent, then retry in aroma.affymetrix.

Cheers

Henrik

parts:
Yes, remove those lines, especially since they don't carry any
information. This will also make it faster to parse/read the file,
which is important since you've got a large number of loci. It's also
advisable to remove the quotes (I cannot remember if they are
automatically dealt with or not).

Cheers

Henrik
